test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What is the main role of the Reserve Bank of India?

options.text: It maintains the profit generated by the banking sector.
It provides fund to the private sector industries.
It conducts consolidated supervision of the financial sector in India.
It lends money to all people.

solution:
The correct answer is **'It conducts consolidated supervision of the financial sector in India.'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Reserve Bank of India was established on** April 1, 1935** in accordance with the provisions of the** Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934.**
 
• It is **India's central bank **and regulatory body responsible for the **regulation of the Indian Banking system.**
 
• It conducts consolidated supervision of the **financial sector in India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Banking Regulation Act, **1949 **empowers the Reserve Bank of India to inspect and supervise commercial banks.
 
• The Reserve Bank of India Act,** 1934** requires the Central Government to entrust the reserve bank with all its **money, remittance, exchange and banking transactions** in India and the **management** of its public debt.
